title: VUA BDL warehouse command v0.3
description: Write commands over the local BDL warehouse (docs/protocols/bdl-commands-v0.3): the artifact-mode trio, the global-default write, and the M5 batch import (warehouse.import). setArtifactMode sets or clears the per-entry artifact-mode override (null clears; resolution stays dynamic: override ?? global default). generateVpm and deleteOriginals submit audited maintenance tasks and return a task acceptance; their completion payloads travel the application-contract task surface, not this schema. setGlobalDefaultMode persists the two-level options' global level into BDL (bdl_meta), superseding the provider's environment-injected initial default from the moment of the write; it is synchronous and never touches entry overrides. warehouse.import submits one batch-import task over the given source folders (one task per command, per-folder progress); entry creation, guards and the audit trail stay inside the task. generateVpm optionally carries importCorrelationId — the audit-chain link proving the task was orchestrated by an import (proposal 010 commitment 6); a manually initiated generation never carries it. The transport envelope (requestId, commandId, correlationId, taskId semantics) belongs to the application contract — this schema freezes the operation closed set and the params. Guards are server-side facts, never client assertions: generateVpm runs only in the generate_vpm effective mode with original material and no existing artifact; deleteOriginals only in the generate_vpm effective mode with a verified generated artifact.

importCorrelationId.description: Present only when the generation was orchestrated by a batch import (proposal 010 commitment 6): the correlation id of the import task the entry came from. A manually initiated generation never carries it.

mode.description: The persisted global default. Unlike the entry-level override there is no null: the global default always has a value (the provider's environment-injected initial default until the first write).

sourceFolders.description: Kernel-resolved absolute paths of the source folders to import, one folder = one material package (one command = one batch-import task with per-folder progress). The warehouse root is provider environment configuration, never a request field.
